lastVerifiedRecord.title: KICK-START ACCESS BASS - OPEN CALL FOR PROPOSALS
lastVerifiedRecord.description: Kick-start Activities are short Feasibility Studies that enable teams to explore new service and application concepts, which make use of space capabilities. Successful Kick-start Activities can be further developed into commercially viable businesses with follow-up support from IAP in the form of a Demonstration Project. Kick-start Activities resulting from thematic calls will be funded at 75%, with ESA providing up to 75,000 per contract.
